question: Which top-level packaging containers, meaning those not contained within any other packaging, have any item for which the total quantity accumulated across all nested levels in the hierarchy exceeds 500, and what are the names of both these containers and the corresponding items?
sql:
-- Verify the final answer with proper CAST to integer
WITH RECURSIVE hierarchy AS (
    SELECT 
        p.id AS top_id,
        p.id AS current_id,
        CAST(1 AS BIGINT) AS path_qty,
        0 AS depth
    FROM packaging p
    WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        h.top_id,
        pr.contains_id AS current_id,
        h.path_qty * pr.qty,
        h.depth + 1
    FROM hierarchy h
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON h.current_id = pr.packaging_id
),
leaf_ids AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT contains_id AS id
    FROM packaging_relations
    WHERE contains_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations)
),
accumulated AS (
    SELECT 
        h.top_id,
        h.current_id AS leaf_id,
        h.path_qty
    FROM hierarchy h
    WHERE h.current_id IN (SELECT id FROM leaf_ids)
),
totals AS (
    SELECT 
        top_id,
        leaf_id,
        SUM(path_qty) AS total_qty
    FROM accumulated
    GROUP BY top_id, leaf_id
)
SELECT 
    p.name AS container_name,
    leaf.name AS item_name,
    t.total_qty
FROM totals t
JOIN packaging p ON p.id = t.top_id
JOIN packaging leaf ON leaf.id = t.leaf_id
WHERE t.total_qty > 500
ORDER BY p.name, leaf.name
